baseline_models.focus_anchor: Q D R at word 2 governs M W T at word 4 through B Y N at word 3, and the negated passive of S B Q at word 7 closes the claim.
baseline_models.mechanism: A measured limit is assigned across the spaces and members of the addressed group. Death is distributive and bounded, while the closing image of failed escape denies any route beyond the assigning power.

activation_trace.role: A quantity reaching its set limit supplies the bounded allotment that governs each death.
The interval among multiple parties supplies the collective field across which the allotment is distributed.
Loss of life and force supplies the concrete terminal limit being apportioned.
Eluding a pursuer or escaping capture supplies the denied possibility of evading the allotter.

changed_reading.before: Death is simply said to be decreed.
changed_reading.after: Each death is a bounded allotment distributed through the human collective, and none can pass beyond the assigning power.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The Q D R-B Y N-M W T construction permits B Y N to carry both separation and an existing bond.
baseline_models.mechanism: B Y N holds severance and interconnection together. Q D R's deliberative ordering therefore makes death a managed cutting of links inside a social web, not only an isolated biological endpoint.

activation_trace.role: Deliberative planning and adjustment supplies the administrative action that orders the severing.
Parting after connection supplies death's removal of a member from existing relations.
A bond joining parties supplies the social fabric within which the separation operates.
The departure of life supplies the event that removes a node from the connected field.
Failure to get beyond the pursuer makes the administration of separation non-circumventable.

changed_reading.after: Death is a planned separation operating inside a connected community and rearranging its relations as members are removed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation as measurement, generative material from which form is measured, and a branch explicitly joining destiny to measured death place life's formation and its terminal bound inside one specification process.

activation_trace.role: The set measure in the focus becomes the terminal component of a larger life specification.
A particular occurrence or mode of death supplies the individually realized terminal specification.
Measuring and proportioning a thing supplies the creation-side counterpart to the focus's apportioning.
Generative fluid from which bodily form is measured supplies the material starting point of the same bounded process.
Measured destiny expressed as death directly bridges generation to the mortality apportioned in the focus.
Origination supplies the agency contrast that locates both the beginning and terminal measure beyond human production.

structural_cues: 56:57-59 move from creation through emitted material to the human-or-divine creator contrast immediately before 56:60.
The repeated first-person plural keeps the agent of creation continuous with the agent apportioning death.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured creation, generative material, and measured death; I infer one specification arc from formation to terminus. A live alternative is that the sequence proves creative power without describing a single lifecycle mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Mortality is allotted only after life has begun.
changed_reading.after: The terminal allotment belongs to the same measuring act that specifies formation from generative material, so death is internal to creaturely design rather than an external interruption.

context_deltas.mechanism: The separation made by death opens a position in the collective; substitution places a counterpart in that position, while new creation can establish the same addressees in an unknown mode. First genesis supplies the remembered precedent for this transition.

activation_trace.role: Separation after connection supplies the vacancy or discontinuity through which replacement operates.
Departure of life supplies the hinge event rather than the mechanism's final state.
One thing standing in another's place supplies succession after the death-created discontinuity.
A counterpart or likeness specifies what can occupy the vacated position without requiring simple identity.
Bringing something newly into being supplies the forward movement beyond mere replacement.
A thing's return toward its outcome lets first genesis function as a precedent whose trajectory reaches re-creation.

structural_cues: 56:61 begins with a construction that directly extends the denied outstripping in 56:60, then coordinates substitution and new creation.
56:62 appeals to the known first genesis as the remembered precedent for the unknown mode.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies death, separation, replacement by likeness, new creation, and first genesis; I infer that death opens the transition slot connecting them. The alternative is a looser proof of power in which death is adjacent but not functionally enabling.

changed_reading.before: Death is the enforced endpoint of an allotted life.
changed_reading.after: Death is the controlled hinge by which one embodied arrangement is removed, counterparts can succeed it, and the dead can be established in an unknown created mode.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human preparation does not secure growth or completion: cultivation is followed by actual causing-to-grow, then by the possibility of dry fragmentation and loss of the expected yield. The focus's death measure becomes controlled withdrawal of vitality within a managed lifecycle.

activation_trace.role: Planned adjustment supplies lifecycle governance rather than a bare date on a calendar.
Causing vitality or intensity to fail supplies the active withdrawal mapped onto the crop sequence.
Casting seed and preparing cultivation supplies the creaturely input that cannot guarantee the lifecycle's outcome.
Causing growth and development supplies the vitality whose continuation remains outside the cultivator's control.
Breaking dry matter into fragments supplies a visible material analogue for terminated vitality.
Failure to obtain the expected good supplies the human experience of an outcome withdrawn despite prior labor.

structural_cues: 56:63-64 repeat the human-or-divine agency contrast used for generation.
56:65-67 move conditionally from living crop to fragments, liability, and deprivation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sowing, growth, fragmentation, and deprivation; I map their preparation-to-vitality-to-withdrawal sequence onto apportioned death. The live alternative is that the crop sequence demonstrates power without modeling human mortality.

changed_reading.before: Death is a fixed terminal appointment detached from life's ordinary processes.
changed_reading.after: Mortality is the governed withdrawal of vitality within a growth system: agents can prepare and cultivate, but cannot secure maturation or prevent reduction to lifeless remainder.

context_deltas.mechanism: Water is delivered, taken as a share, placed from above, and capable of being changed into an unusable condition. This sharpens Q D R plus B Y N into allocation infrastructure: mortality is a bounded share distributed among recipients under upstream control.

activation_trace.role: A bounded amount supplies the quantitative logic of an allotted share.
The interval among many recipients supplies the distribution field.
A particular occurrence of death supplies the individually realized unit within the collective distribution.
Conveying water by pouring or irrigation supplies a concrete delivery system for the allocation analogy.
An apportioned water share supplies the recipient-side image that sharpens death as an assigned portion.
Putting a thing in its proper station supplies controlled placement within the distribution system.
Rendering a thing into another condition supplies the controller's ability to alter the delivered allotment.
Bitter saline water supplies the unusable condition that demonstrates control over quality as well as delivery.

structural_cues: 56:68-70 form a perception question, an agency contrast, and a conditional quality reversal.
The sequence addresses a universally received necessity rather than a product humans can originate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivery, recipient share, placement, and quality alteration; I transfer that allocation architecture to Q D R-B Y N. The alternative is that water is only a parallel gift and does not specify how death is distributed.

changed_reading.before: Between you merely locates death among people.
changed_reading.after: Between you can describe apportionment across recipients: each realizes a bounded mortality share whose placement and condition remain controlled upstream.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it treats death as a quiescent phase rather than sheer extinction. It remains anchored in M W T's quiescence extension and Q D R's deliberate ordering, while hidden fire, new creation, and useful provision supply the analogy. Downstream prose should present it as a phase-transition image, not claim that death lexically means stored energy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: M W T at word 4 can extend to stillness or dormancy, held under the deliberate Q D R verb at word 2.

activation_trace.role: Stillness or dormancy like sleep and a wind falling quiet supplies a non-annihilative edge of death.
Deliberate preparation supplies control over the transition into and beyond quiescence.
Fire latent in a fire-stick and then released supplies hidden capacity within apparently inert material.
Interwoven bearing wood supplies the material carrier in which the hidden capacity is held.
Bringing something newly into being supplies the possible release into another created mode.
A provision used for needs and passage turns the released capacity into a means of onward movement.

changed_reading.before: Death is total absence of capacity.
changed_reading.after: Death may be explored as a controlled quiescent phase in which presently hidden capacity is not outside the power that can establish another created mode.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it uses three packet-sanctioned mappings of S M W in the closing naming command, including a non-dominant branch that names death. It remains anchored to the focus's explicit M W T and planned Q D R. Downstream prose must call this a split-root resonance about designation and boundary, never an etymological claim that the word for name means death here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Explicit M W T at word 4 is deliberately apportioned by Q D R at word 2; the final naming command provides the cross-root resonance.

activation_trace.role: Deliberative assignment supplies death as a boundary set rather than an accidental label.
Actual loss of life keeps the exploratory designation model anchored to the focus's concrete death.
A name as designation supplies the identity-bearing side of the resonance.
A visible identifying mark supplies the image of mortality as a delimiting sign on a present mode.
The split target's death branch supplies the strange but explicit bridge between naming and the focus's mortality.

changed_reading.before: Death is an event imposed on otherwise stable identities.
changed_reading.after: Death can be explored as the assigned boundary-mark that delimits an identity's present mode, with the final naming command resonating across designation, mark, and death.

strongest_changes: Creation and generative-material branches move the terminal measure inside the specification of creaturely life.
The grammatical continuation in 56:61-62 turns death from endpoint into the hinge of replacement and unknown re-creation.
Cultivation and water sequences recast mortality as governed withdrawal and collective allocation in systems whose users cannot secure outcomes.
summary.what_was_special: The most distinctive activations came from B Y N's separation-bond duality, M N Y's meeting of generative material and measured death, W R Y's hidden fire, and S M W's non-dominant name-mark-death split.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether B Y N primarily marks social distribution or only locates mortality among people.
Whether the crop and water mechanisms genuinely specify 56:60 or remain adjacent demonstrations of power.
The hidden-fire and S M W readings must remain analogical and form-distant rather than lexical replacements.
